name: Andermatt cadastral DH routing benchmark
boundary_rule: axis-aligned bounding box of all operator-owned observed house-transfer points, expanded by 250 m; local inlet fixed at the northern mapped feed crossing
thermal_input_basis: uniform scenario load; no measured customer heat demands are available
source_basis: mapped incoming trunk crossing the northern boundary; supplied as a local distribution inlet to both tools; upstream Göschenen plant and Bergleitung excluded
benchmark_scope: conditional local-distribution route reconstruction with observed transfer and inlet coordinates supplied to both tools
reference_route_use: held out from construction except the explicitly supplied inlet and consumer locations
original_table_xii_case: 85 current cadastral transfer points; not a reproduction of the earlier 50-transfer-station sample
reference_quality: mapped active corridors; physical connectivity is inferred from 2D geometry, and the public consumer point layer is not assumed exhaustive
